preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of teams is between 2 and 100.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == sum((n * (n - 1)) // 2 for n in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:]])
postconditions.description: The total number of output integers matches the total number of games across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(all(result in [-1, 0, 1] for result in map(int, stdout.split()[start:start + (n * (n - 1)) // 2])) for start, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:]], 0))
postconditions.description: Each result of a game is either -1, 0, or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(map(lambda x: 3 if x == 1 else 1 if x == 0 else 0, map(int, stdout.split()[start:start + (n * (n - 1)) // 2]))) == n for start, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.strip().split('\n')[1:]], 0))
postconditions.description: Each team has the same score, which is equal to n.
